gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1274 experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves by $7.197 million in 2016, representing a 1.51% deterioration of its opening gross claims outstanding. This deterioration was primarily driven by adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration related to claims outstanding from the previous year end (2015). Specifically, Professional Indemnity (Professional Lines) experienced heavy back-year claims experience resulting in an $11.2 million loss for the class. The Marine Excess of Loss portfolio also continued to bear the burden of deterioration from prior events such as the 2015 Tianjin explosion, and the 2016 Tullow Oil loss and Amos 6 rocket incident.
